question: Who among the following won the 'Player of the Match' award at the final of the ICC Cricket World Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ben Stokes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ben Stokes** won the 'Player of the Match' award at the final of the ICC Cricket World Cup 2019.
 
• The final match was held on **14th July 2019** at Lord's, London.
 
• Stokes played a crucial role in England's victory against New Zealand, scoring **84 not out** in the regular play and contributing significantly in the Super Over.
 
• This was England's first-ever ICC Cricket World Cup win.
 
• The match was highly dramatic and ended in a tie, leading to a Super Over, which also ended in a tie. England won based on the boundary count rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Cricket World Cup is an international cricket championship organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) every four years.
 
• The 2019 World Cup was the 12th edition of the tournament.
 
• England's win in 2019 was historic as it was their first World Cup victory despite being the host country multiple times.
 
• The Player of the Match award is given to the player who has the most impact in a particular match, often contributing significantly to their team's performance.
